title: thlaspi perfoliatum subsp. virgatum
intro: Thlaspi perfoliatum subsp. virgatum, commonly known as Shepherd's Cress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Shepherd's Cress include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as acting as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
